policy_notes: Thresholds are frozen from three calibration prompts, 39 captured tensors from layers 0/15/29, full and sharded logits, teacher-forcing logits and one incremental decode sequence.
Per-lm_head-shard rank is diagnostic; each shard is still gated numerically and by exact vocabulary position through the declared-reference slice.
Official free-generation divergence is reported, not used as the backend numeric gate.
Complete acceptance requires numeric and quality evidence plus sealed calibration and acceptance observation bundles.

performance.measurement: 3 independent generate() requests in one process; each resets persistent KV state and requests 32 tokens

raw_aggregate_stats_not_used_for_per_tok.note: These totals cover prefill + decode + sampling and are not divided by a fixed token count.

timing_definitions.decode_ms: sum of decode_one() forward intervals only
timing_definitions.generate_wall_ms: full generate() interval including reset, prefill, all sampling, all decode forwards and Python control
timing_definitions.per_decode_forward: stage delta summed over decode forwards divided by actual decode forward count
timing_definitions.ttft_ms: reset + prefill + first sampling action inside generate(); excludes process/model load, chat tokenization and detokenization
